title: onagra muricata
intro: Onagra muricata, commonly known as Evening Primrose, is a flowering plant native to North America. The health benefits of Evening Primrose include reducing inflammation and improving symptoms of eczema, as well as providing relief from menstrual cramps and menopausal symptoms. The therapeutic actions of the plant include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antiseptic properties, which aid in soothing skin irritations and alleviating digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Evening Primrose include gamma-linolenic acid (GLA), which has been shown to possess potent anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
